records.literal_gloss: For the director, with stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph, a song.

en.L: For the director: with stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph, a song.
en.B: For the music director. With stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments. A song of Asaph.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : avec instruments à cordes. Psaume d’Asaph, cantique.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Avec instruments à cordes. Psaume d’Asaph. Cantique.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des instruments à cordes. Chant d’Asaph.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa vinanda. Zaburi ya Asafu, wimbo.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa vinanda. Zaburi ya Asafu. Wimbo.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa vinanda. Wimbo wa Asafu.

es.L: Al director del coro: con instrumentos de cuerda. Salmo de Asaf, cántico.
es.B: Al director del coro. Con instrumentos de cuerda. Salmo de Asaf. Cántico.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con instrumentos de cuerda. Canto de Asaf.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: với đàn dây. [Một] thi thiên của A-sáp, [một] bài ca.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Với đàn dây. Thi thiên của A-sáp. Bài ca.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Để chơi bằng đàn dây. Bài ca của A-sáp.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어. 아삽의 시, 노래.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어. 아삽의 시. 노래.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. 현악기로 연주하는 노래. 아삽이 지은 노래.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: stringed instruments: to be accompanied on strings
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, the word (neginot) is used for music played on strings.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work (1 Chronicles 25:1-2). Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: "vinanda" (stringed instruments) for neginot
decisions.reason: The English translates the word as "stringed instruments"; "vinanda" is the common Swahili word for instruments played on strings.

decisions.choice: "현악기에 맞추어" (L, B), "현악기로 연주하는 노래" (R) for neginot
alternatives: "느기놋", the Hebrew kept as a name
decisions.reason: The English translates the word at every level (meaning decision: to be accompanied on strings), so Korean translates it too, as the terms note says.

source.text: נוֹדָ֣ע בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Known in Judah [is] God; in Israel great [is] his name.

en.L: God [is] known in Judah; \q in Israel {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name [is] great.
en.B: God has made {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known in Judah; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name stands high in Israel.
en.R: The people of Judah know who God is. \q In Israel everyone honors {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.

fr.L: Dieu [est] connu en Juda ; \q en Israël {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom [est] grand.
fr.B: Dieu s’est fait connaître en Juda ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est grand en Israël.
fr.R: Le peuple de Juda sait qui est Dieu. \q En Israël, tout le monde honore {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: Mungu anajulikana katika Yuda; \q katika Israeli jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} [ni] kuu.
sw.B: Mungu amejitambulisha katika Yuda; \q jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} limetukuka katika Israeli.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda wanamjua Mungu ni nani. \q Katika Israeli kila mtu analiheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

es.L: Dios [es] conocido en Judá; \q en Israel {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre [es] grande.
es.B: Dios se ha dado a conocer en Judá; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre es muy alto en Israel.
es.R: El pueblo de Judá sabe quién es Dios. \q En Israel todos honran {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời [được] biết đến ở Giu-đa; \q tại Y-sơ-ra-ên danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thật] lớn.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời đã tỏ mình ra tại Giu-đa; \q danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa biết Đức Chúa Trời là ai. \q Trong Y-sơ-ra-ên mọi người đều tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 하나님은 유다에 알려지셨고, \q 이스라엘에서 그분의 이름이 크시다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 유다에 자신을 알리셨으니, \q 그분의 이름이 이스라엘에서 높임을 받는다.
ko.R: 유다 백성은 하나님이 어떤 분이신지 안다. \q 이스라엘에서 모든 사람이 그분의 이름을 높인다.

decisions.choice: a song of Zion
decisions.reason: Like Psalms 46, 48 and 87, this psalm celebrates Zion, Jerusalem, as the place where God lives and from which he breaks the power of the armies that come against it (verses 4-7). Its picture of an army struck down in its sleep recalls the night the Assyrian army besieging Jerusalem was struck (Isaiah 37:36), and the ancient Greek translation adds "concerning the Assyrian" to the title.

decisions.choice: known: made known by what he has done
decisions.reason: The form (noda') means "is known" or "has made himself known": God is known in Judah because he has acted there (9:17).

decisions.choice: his name: his fame, God as he is known
decisions.reason: A great name is a great reputation; God's name stands for God himself as people know him (8:2).

decisions.choice: Verses 2-4 and 13 speak of God in the plain written style with the honorific; verses 5-11 address God in 합쇼체 as "주님"; verse 12 tells the hearers in 해라체 to vow and pay
alternatives: one speech level for the whole psalm
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a; the psalm turns from speaking about God to speaking to him (verse 5, "you") and to the people (verse 12, "your God").

records.literal_gloss: And was in Salem his lair, and his den in Zion.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} lair was in Salem, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} den in Zion.
en.B: His lair is set in Salem, \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} den in Zion.
en.R: He has made Jerusalem {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home. \q Like a lion in its den, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives on Mount Zion.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} repaire était à Salem, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tanière en Sion.
fr.B: Son repaire est à Salem, \q {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tanière en Sion.
fr.R: Il a fait de Jérusalem {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison. \q Comme un lion dans sa tanière, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite sur la montagne de Sion.

sw.L: Na makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yalikuwa Salemu, \q na pango {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} katika Sayuni.
sw.B: Makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yamewekwa Salemu, \q pango {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} katika Sayuni.
sw.R: Ameifanya Yerusalemu kuwa nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Kama simba katika pango lake, anakaa juu ya mlima Sayuni.

es.L: Y en Salem estaba {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} guarida, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cueva en Sion.
es.B: Su guarida está en Salem, \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cueva en Sion.
es.R: Él ha hecho de Jerusalén {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hogar. \q Como un león en su cueva, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive en el monte Sion.

vi.L: Và hang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ở Sa-lem, \q và nơi ở của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại Si-ôn.
vi.B: Hang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt tại Sa-lem, \q nơi ở của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại Si-ôn.
vi.R: Ngài đã lấy Giê-ru-sa-lem làm nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Như sư tử trong hang mình, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở trên núi Si-ôn.

ko.L: 그분의 거처가 살렘에 있었고, \q 그분의 굴이 시온에 [있었다].
ko.B: 그분의 보금자리가 살렘에 있고, \q 그분의 굴이 시온에 있다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 예루살렘을 그분의 집으로 삼으셨다. \q 사자가 굴에서 지내듯 시온 산에 머무르신다.

decisions.choice: Salem: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Salem is an old name for Jerusalem; Melchizedek was king of Salem (Genesis 14:18). It stands in parallel with Zion, the hill of the city where the temple stood.

decisions.choice: lair and den: the shelter of a lion
decisions.reason: The two words (sok, me'onah) can mean a hut or a dwelling, but both are used of a lion's lair (10:9; Jeremiah 25:38; Job 38:40). God is pictured as a lion who rises from his den to defend his city.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem; Like a lion in its den
decisions.reason: Readable names the city (m1) and makes the picture a comparison (m2).

source.text: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: There he broke [the] flames of [the] bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.

en.L: There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke the flames of the bow, \q shield and sword and battle. Selah
en.B: There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shattered the fiery shafts of the bow, \q shield and sword and all the gear of battle. Selah
en.R: There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke the enemy's burning arrows, \q their shields and swords, and everything they used to fight. Selah

fr.L: Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brisé les flammes de l’arc, \q le bouclier, l’épée et la bataille. Sélah
fr.B: Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brisé les traits enflammés de l’arc, \q le bouclier, l’épée et tout l’attirail du combat. Sélah
fr.R: Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brisé les flèches brûlantes de l’ennemi, \q leurs boucliers, leurs épées et tout ce qui leur servait à combattre. Sélah

sw.L: Huko alivunja mishale ya moto ya upinde, \q ngao na upanga na vita. Sela
sw.B: Huko alivunjavunja mishale ya moto ya upinde, \q ngao na upanga na zana zote za vita. Sela
sw.R: Huko alivunja mishale ya moto ya adui, \q ngao zao na panga zao, na kila kitu walichotumia kupigana. Sela

es.L: Allí {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quebró las llamas del arco, \q el escudo y la espada y la guerra. Selah
es.B: Allí {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo pedazos las flechas encendidas del arco, \q el escudo y la espada y todas las armas de la guerra. Selah
es.R: Allí {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} rompió las flechas encendidas del enemigo, \q sus escudos y espadas, y todo lo que usaban para pelear. Selah

vi.L: Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bẻ gãy những ngọn lửa của cây cung, \q cái khiên, gươm và chiến trận. Sê-la
vi.B: Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bẻ gãy những mũi tên lửa của cây cung, \q cái khiên, thanh gươm và mọi khí cụ chiến tranh. Sê-la
vi.R: Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bẻ gãy những mũi tên lửa của kẻ thù, \q khiên và gươm của chúng, và mọi thứ chúng dùng để đánh trận. Sê-la

ko.L: 거기서 그분께서 활의 불꽃들과 \q 방패와 칼과 전쟁을 꺾으셨다. 셀라
ko.B: 거기서 그분께서 불붙은 화살들과 \q 방패와 칼과 온갖 무기를 부수셨다. 셀라
ko.R: 거기서 그분께서 원수들의 불화살을 꺾으시고, \q 그들의 방패와 칼과 싸움에 쓰던 모든 것을 부수셨다. 셀라

decisions.choice: flames of the bow: arrows
decisions.reason: The word (reshef) means a flame or flash. "Flames of the bow" are arrows, flashing as they fly, or arrows set alight.

decisions.choice: battle: the weapons of battle
decisions.reason: After shield and sword, "battle" stands for every weapon of war (Hosea 2, where God breaks bow, sword and battle). God ends the war by breaking the weapons (46:10).

decisions.choice: the enemy's
decisions.reason: Readable names whose weapons were broken, the armies that came against the city.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: Shining [are] you, majestic, more than [the] mountains of prey.

en.L: Shining [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, majestic, \q more than the mountains of prey.
en.B: You shine with light, \q in greater splendor than the mountains of prey.
en.R: You shine with glory! \q You are more splendid than the mountains where wild beasts hunt.

fr.L: Resplendissant [es-]{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, majestueux, \q plus que les montagnes de proie.
fr.B: Tu brilles de lumière, \q plus splendide que les montagnes de proie.
fr.R: Tu brilles de gloire ! \q Tu es plus splendide que les montagnes où chassent les bêtes sauvages.

sw.L: Unang'aa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, mwenye utukufu, \q kuliko milima ya mawindo.
sw.B: Wewe unang'aa kwa nuru, \q kwa fahari kuliko milima ya mawindo.
sw.R: Wewe unang'aa kwa utukufu! \q Wewe ni wa fahari kuliko milima ambako wanyama wakali huwinda.

es.L: Resplandeciente [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, majestuoso, \q más que los montes de la presa.
es.B: Tú brillas con luz, \q con mayor esplendor que los montes de la presa.
es.R: ¡Tú brillas con gloria! \q Eres más espléndido que los montes donde cazan las fieras.

vi.L: Ngài [thật] rực rỡ, oai nghi, \q hơn những núi của mồi săn.
vi.B: Ngài chiếu sáng rực rỡ, \q huy hoàng hơn những núi đầy mồi săn.
vi.R: Ngài chiếu sáng đầy vinh quang! \q Ngài huy hoàng hơn những ngọn núi nơi thú dữ săn mồi.

ko.L: 주님은 빛나시며 위엄이 있으십니다, \q 사냥감의 산들보다 더.
ko.B: 주님께서는 빛으로 빛나시니, \q 사냥감이 가득한 산들보다 더 찬란하십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 영광으로 빛나십니다! \q 들짐승이 사냥하는 산들보다 더 찬란하십니다.

decisions.choice: shining: full of light
decisions.reason: The form (na'or) means lit up or radiant: God appears in blazing light, like the light in which he came from Sinai (Deuteronomy 33:2).

decisions.choice: mountains of prey: where beasts of prey hunt
alternatives: returning from the mountains with the spoil
decisions.reason: The phrase continues the lion picture of verse 3. It may mean the mountains where beasts of prey live, or the hills from which God returns with the spoil of the beaten army (verse 6). Either way God is greater than all that is fierce and strong.

decisions.choice: of prey
alternatives: the everlasting mountains (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "everlasting mountains", from a word that looks much like "prey" in the Hebrew script. The words follow the Hebrew text.

source.text: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ׀אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־מָצְא֖וּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They were plundered, [the] mighty of heart; they slept their sleep, and not found all [the] men of strength their hands.

en.L: The mighty of heart were plundered; they slept their sleep, \q and none of the men of strength found their hands.
en.B: The brave were stripped bare; they dropped into their final sleep, \q and not one of the warriors could find a hand to raise.
en.R: The proud soldiers were robbed of all they had. They fell asleep and never woke up. \q Not one of those strong fighters could even lift a hand.

fr.L: Ils ont été dépouillés, les vaillants de cœur ; ils ont dormi leur sommeil, \q et aucun des hommes de force n’a trouvé ses mains.
fr.B: Les braves ont été dépouillés ; ils ont sombré dans leur dernier sommeil, \q et aucun des guerriers n’a trouvé la force de lever la main.
fr.R: Les soldats orgueilleux ont perdu tout ce qu’ils avaient. Ils se sont endormis et ne se sont jamais réveillés. \q Aucun de ces combattants si forts n’a pu même lever la main.

sw.L: Mashujaa wa moyo wametekwa nyara; wamelala usingizi wao, \q wala hakuna hata mmoja wa watu wa nguvu aliyeipata mikono yake.
sw.B: Mashujaa wamenyang'anywa kila kitu; wamelala usingizi wao wa mwisho, \q wala hakuna hata mmoja wa wapiganaji aliyeweza kuinua mkono.
sw.R: Askari wenye kiburi walinyang'anywa vyote walivyokuwa navyo. Walilala usingizi na hawakuamka tena. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wa wapiganaji hao hodari aliyeweza kuinua mkono.

es.L: Los valientes de corazón fueron despojados; durmieron su sueño, \q y ninguno de los hombres de fuerza halló sus manos.
es.B: Los valientes quedaron despojados; cayeron en su último sueño, \q y ni uno de los guerreros pudo levantar la mano.
es.R: Los soldados orgullosos perdieron todo lo que tenían. Se durmieron y nunca despertaron. \q Ni uno de aquellos fuertes guerreros pudo siquiera levantar una mano.

vi.L: Những kẻ có lòng dũng mãnh đã bị cướp sạch; chúng đã ngủ giấc ngủ của chúng, \q và không ai trong những người mạnh sức tìm thấy tay mình.
vi.B: Những dũng sĩ bị lột sạch; chúng đã chìm vào giấc ngủ cuối cùng, \q và không một chiến binh nào còn nhấc nổi tay.
vi.R: Những người lính kiêu hãnh bị cướp hết mọi thứ. Chúng ngủ thiếp đi và không bao giờ thức dậy nữa. \q Không một ai trong những chiến binh mạnh mẽ ấy còn nhấc nổi tay.

ko.L: 마음이 굳센 자들이 약탈을 당하고 그들의 잠을 잤으며, \q 힘 있는 사람들이 모두 그들의 손을 찾지 못하였습니다.
ko.B: 용사들이 가진 것을 다 빼앗기고 마지막 잠에 빠졌으며, \q 전사들 가운데 손 하나 들 수 있는 이가 없었습니다.
ko.R: 교만한 군인들이 가진 것을 다 빼앗겼습니다. 그들은 잠들어 다시는 깨어나지 못했습니다. \q 그 힘센 용사들 가운데 손 하나라도 들 수 있는 사람이 없었습니다.

decisions.choice: slept their sleep: died
decisions.reason: Sleep here is the sleep of death, as in 13:4 and Jeremiah 51:39, 57. The army that came to plunder is plundered.

decisions.choice: did not find their hands: were helpless
decisions.reason: Not finding one's hands means having no strength to use them. The strong men could do nothing.

decisions.choice: final sleep (B); never woke up (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make plain that the sleep is death (m1).

source.text: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃

records.literal_gloss: From your rebuke, God of Jacob, [was] sleeping both chariot and horse.

en.L: At {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rebuke, God of Jacob, \q both chariot and horse [were] in deep sleep.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rebuked them, God of Jacob, \q chariot and horse sank into a stupor.
en.R: God of Jacob, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} shouted at them, \q their chariots and horses lay still as if dead.

fr.L: À {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} menace, Dieu de Jacob, \q char et cheval [ont été plongés] dans un profond sommeil.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as menacés, Dieu de Jacob, \q chars et chevaux sont tombés dans la torpeur.
fr.R: Dieu de Jacob, quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as crié dessus, \q leurs chars et leurs chevaux sont restés immobiles, comme morts.

sw.L: Kwa kukemea {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo, \q gari na farasi [walikuwa] katika usingizi mzito.
sw.B: Wewe ulipowakemea, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo, \q gari la vita na farasi walizimia.
sw.R: Mungu wa Yakobo, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulipowapigia kelele, \q magari yao ya vita na farasi wao walilala bila kutikisika kana kwamba wamekufa.

es.L: Ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprensión, oh Dios de Jacob, \q el carro y el caballo [quedaron] en sueño profundo.
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los reprendiste, oh Dios de Jacob, \q carro y caballo cayeron en un sopor.
es.R: Dios de Jacob, cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} les gritaste, \q sus carros y caballos quedaron tendidos como muertos.

vi.L: Bởi lời quở trách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp, \q cả xe chiến mã lẫn ngựa [đều] ngủ say.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách chúng, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp, \q cả xe chiến lẫn ngựa đều chìm vào cơn mê.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quát lên với chúng, \q xe chiến và ngựa của chúng nằm im như đã chết.

ko.L: 야곱의 하나님, 주님의 꾸짖으심에 \q 병거와 말이 모두 깊은 잠에 [빠졌습니다].
ko.B: 야곱의 하나님, 주님께서 꾸짖으시니 \q 병거와 말이 정신을 잃고 쓰러졌습니다.
ko.R: 야곱의 하나님, 주님께서 호령하시니 \q 그들의 병거와 말이 죽은 듯이 꼼짝하지 않았습니다.

decisions.choice: rebuke: God's battle cry
decisions.reason: God's rebuke (ge'arah) is the angry shout that drives back enemies and even the sea (18:16; 104:7). One word from him stops an army.

decisions.choice: sleeping: in a deep, deathlike sleep
decisions.reason: The verb (radam) is used of a heavy sleep from which one does not easily wake (Judges 4:21; Daniel 10:9).

decisions.choice: chariot and horse: as at the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The words recall God's victory over Pharaoh's chariots and horses at the sea (Exodus 14:23; 15:1, 21).

source.text: אַתָּ֤ה׀נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: You — fearsome [are] you, and who will stand before you from [the] time of your anger?

en.L: You — {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] fearsome! \q And who will stand before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} \q from the moment of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger?
en.B: You, yes, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are to be feared! \q When {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger blazes, \q who can hold out in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence?
en.R: You are the one everyone should fear! \q When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are angry, no one can stand up to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Toi, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es] redoutable ! \q Et qui tiendra devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} \q dès le moment de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ?
fr.B: Toi, oui, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es redoutable ! \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère s’enflamme, \q qui peut tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?
fr.R: C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que tout le monde doit craindre ! \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es en colère, personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} résister.

sw.L: Wewe, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ni] wa kutisha! \q Na ni nani atakayesimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} \q tangu wakati wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}?
sw.B: Wewe, naam, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe wa kuogopwa! \q Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inapowaka, \q ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}?
sw.R: Wewe ndiwe ambaye kila mtu anapaswa kukuogopa! \q Unapokasirika, hakuna awezaye kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: ¡Tú, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] temible! \q ¿Y quién se mantendrá en pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} \q desde el momento de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira?
es.B: ¡Tú, sí, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres digno de temor! \q Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira se enciende, \q ¿quién puede resistir en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia?
es.R: ¡Tú eres a quien todos deben temer! \q Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} enojas, nadie puede hacerte frente.

vi.L: Ngài, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thật] đáng sợ! \q Và ai sẽ đứng nổi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q từ lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận?
vi.B: Ngài, phải, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật đáng kính sợ! \q Khi cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bừng lên, \q ai có thể đứng vững trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Ngài là Đấng mọi người phải kính sợ! \q Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận, không ai có thể chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님, 주님은 두려우신 분[이십니다]! \q 누가 주님 앞에 설 수 있겠습니까, \q 주님께서 진노하시는 그때부터?
ko.B: 주님, 바로 주님은 두려워할 분이십니다! \q 주님의 진노가 타오를 때 \q 누가 주님 앞에서 버틸 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 모든 사람이 두려워해야 할 분은 주님이십니다! \q 주님께서 노하시면 아무도 주님께 맞설 수 없습니다.

decisions.choice: you, you: strongly emphatic
decisions.reason: The pronoun is said twice for emphasis: God and no one else is to be feared.

decisions.choice: from the time of your anger: as soon as you are angry
decisions.reason: The words (me'az 'appekha) mean "from then of your anger", that is, once your anger is roused no one can stand (Nahum 1, where no one stands before his fury).

decisions.choice: no one can stand up to you
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies.

source.text: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃

records.literal_gloss: From heaven you made heard judgment; [the] earth feared and was quiet,

en.L: From heaven {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made judgment heard; \q [the] earth feared and was still,
en.B: From heaven {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} announced {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} verdict; \q the earth was afraid and fell silent,
en.R: You announced {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sentence from heaven. \q The whole earth was afraid and became silent.

fr.L: Du ciel {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait entendre le jugement ; \q [la] terre a eu peur et s’est tue,
fr.B: Du ciel {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sentence ; \q la terre a eu peur et s’est tue,
fr.R: Du ciel, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as annoncé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sentence. \q Toute la terre a eu peur et s’est tue.

sw.L: Kutoka mbinguni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulifanya hukumu isikike; \q dunia iliogopa na kutulia,
sw.B: Kutoka mbinguni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulitangaza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q dunia iliogopa ikanyamaza,
sw.R: Ulitangaza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kutoka mbinguni. \q Dunia yote iliogopa, ikanyamaza kimya.

es.L: Desde el cielo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste oír [el] juicio; \q [la] tierra temió y quedó quieta,
es.B: Desde el cielo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} anunciaste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veredicto; \q la tierra tuvo miedo y se quedó callada,
es.R: Tú anunciaste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sentencia desde el cielo. \q Toda la tierra tuvo miedo y se quedó en silencio.

vi.L: Từ trời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho nghe sự phán xét; \q đất đã sợ hãi và lặng yên,
vi.B: Từ trời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q đất sợ hãi và im lặng,
vi.R: Ngài đã công bố bản án của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ trời. \q Cả trái đất sợ hãi và trở nên im lặng.

ko.L: 하늘에서 주님께서 심판을 들려주시니, \q 땅이 두려워하며 잠잠하였습니다.
ko.B: 하늘에서 주님께서 판결을 알리시니, \q 땅이 두려워 잠잠해졌습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 하늘에서 판결을 알리셨습니다. \q 온 땅이 두려워 조용해졌습니다.

decisions.choice: judgment: a verdict
decisions.reason: The word (din) is the decision of a judge. God pronounces his verdict from heaven, and the whole earth hears it.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 10 tells when this happened ("when God rose"), so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

records.literal_gloss: when arose for judgment God to save all [the] humble of [the] earth. Selah.

en.L: when God arose for judgment, \q to save all the humble of the earth. Selah
en.B: when God stood up to give judgment \q and to rescue all the lowly on earth. Selah
en.R: That happened when God stood up to judge \q and to save all the people on earth who were poor and crushed. Selah

fr.L: quand Dieu s’est levé pour le jugement, \q pour sauver tous les humbles de la terre. Sélah
fr.B: quand Dieu s’est levé pour juger \q et pour délivrer tous les humbles de la terre. Sélah
fr.R: Cela s’est passé quand Dieu s’est levé pour juger \q et pour sauver tous les gens de la terre qui étaient pauvres et écrasés. Sélah

sw.L: Mungu alipoinuka kwa hukumu, \q ili kuwaokoa wanyenyekevu wote wa dunia. Sela
sw.B: Mungu aliposimama kutoa hukumu \q na kuwaokoa wanyonge wote duniani. Sela
sw.R: Hayo yalitokea Mungu aliposimama kuhukumu \q na kuwaokoa watu wote duniani waliokuwa maskini na kukandamizwa. Sela

es.L: cuando Dios se levantó para el juicio, \q para salvar a todos los humildes de la tierra. Selah
es.B: cuando Dios se puso en pie para juzgar \q y rescatar a todos los humildes de la tierra. Selah
es.R: Eso pasó cuando Dios se levantó para juzgar \q y para salvar a toda la gente de la tierra que era pobre y estaba oprimida. Selah

vi.L: khi Đức Chúa Trời trỗi dậy để phán xét, \q để cứu mọi người khiêm nhường trên đất. Sê-la
vi.B: khi Đức Chúa Trời đứng dậy thi hành sự phán xét \q và giải cứu mọi người hèn mọn trên đất. Sê-la
vi.R: Điều đó xảy ra khi Đức Chúa Trời đứng dậy xét xử \q và giải cứu mọi người trên đất đang nghèo khổ và bị chà đạp. Sê-la

ko.L: 하나님께서 심판하러 일어나셨을 때, \q 땅의 겸손한 이들을 모두 구원하시려고. 셀라
ko.B: 하나님께서 심판하러 일어나셔서 \q 땅의 낮은 사람들을 모두 구하실 때였습니다. 셀라
ko.R: 그때는 하나님께서 심판하시려고 일어나신 때였습니다. \q 땅 위의 가난하고 짓밟힌 사람들을 모두 구하시려고 일어나신 때였습니다. 셀라

decisions.choice: the humble: the poor and oppressed
decisions.reason: The word ('anavim) means people who are low, poor and oppressed, and who depend on God (9:19; 37:11). God's judgment is their rescue.

decisions.choice: the earth
decisions.reason: The word ('erets) can mean the whole earth or the land of Israel. After verse 9 it is taken as the earth.

decisions.choice: That happened
decisions.reason: Readable begins a new sentence, so it links it to verse 9.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] wrath of humankind will praise you; [the] remainder of wraths you will gird on.

en.L: For the wrath of humankind will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q the remnant of wrath {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will gird on.
en.B: Even human fury will end in praise for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q what is left of it {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will tie on like a belt.
en.R: Even when people rage against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, it ends in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise. \q You will take whatever anger is left and wear it like a belt.

fr.L: Car la fureur des humains {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louera ; \q du reste des fureurs {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ceindras.
fr.B: Même la fureur humaine finira par {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louer ; \q ce qui en reste, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’attacheras comme une ceinture.
fr.R: Même quand les gens se mettent en colère contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, cela finit par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange. \q Tu prendras toute la colère qui reste et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} la porteras comme une ceinture.

sw.L: Kwa maana ghadhabu ya wanadamu itakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q mabaki ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utajifunga.
sw.B: Hata ghadhabu ya wanadamu itaishia katika kukusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q kile kinachobaki {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utakifunga kama mshipi.
sw.R: Hata watu wanapokughadhibikia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, mwisho wake ni sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. \q Utachukua hasira yoyote iliyobaki na kuivaa kama mshipi.

es.L: Porque la ira del ser humano {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabará; \q con el resto de la ira {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ceñirás.
es.B: Aun el furor humano terminará en alabanza para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q lo que quede de él {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lo atarás como un cinturón.
es.R: Aun cuando la gente se enfurece contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, todo termina en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza. \q Tú tomarás el enojo que quede y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lo pondrás como un cinturón.

vi.L: Vì cơn giận của loài người sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q phần còn lại của cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thắt vào lưng.
vi.B: Ngay cả cơn giận dữ của loài người cũng sẽ kết thúc bằng lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q phần còn lại của nó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thắt vào mình như dây lưng.
vi.R: Ngay cả khi người ta nổi giận chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, điều đó cũng kết thúc bằng lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài sẽ lấy phần giận dữ còn lại mà đeo như dây lưng.

ko.L: 참으로 사람의 분노가 주님을 찬양하고, \q 분노의 남은 것을 주님께서 띠로 두르실 것입니다.
ko.B: 사람의 분노조차 결국 주님께 찬양이 되고, \q 남은 분노는 주님께서 허리띠처럼 매실 것입니다.
ko.R: 사람들이 주님께 화를 내며 대들어도 결국 주님을 찬양하게 됩니다. \q 주님께서는 남은 분노를 허리띠처럼 두르실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: the wrath of humankind will praise you: human rage ends by bringing God praise
alternatives: your wrath against humankind brings you praise
decisions.reason: The rage of the nations against God's people only gives God an occasion to show his power, so in the end it brings him praise. The words can also mean God's anger against people.

decisions.choice: the remainder of wraths you will gird on
alternatives: you will restrain the rest of their rage
the survivors of wrath will keep a feast to you (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: This line is hard. "Gird" means to put on as a belt: God wears the last of the fury as a trophy, or girds himself with his own anger. Some take the verb as "restrain". The ancient Greek translation reads "the remnant of wrath will keep a feast to you".

decisions.choice: people rage against you
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain whose anger is meant (m1).

source.text: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהוָ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כָּל־סְבִיבָ֑יו יוֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Vow and pay to YHWH your God; all [those] around him, let them bring a gift to the Fearsome [One].

en.L: Vow and pay [your vows] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God; \q let all who are around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q bring a gift to the Fearsome One.
en.B: Vow to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and keep what you vow; \q let all who surround {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q bring tribute to the One who inspires fear.
en.R: Make promises to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and then keep them. \q Let all the nations around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q bring gifts to the God everyone must fear.

fr.L: Faites des vœux et acquittez[-les] {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu ; \q que tous ceux qui sont autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q apportent un présent au Redoutable.
fr.B: Faites des vœux {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et tenez ce que vous avez promis ; \q que tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent \q apportent leur tribut à celui qui inspire la crainte.
fr.R: Faites des promesses {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, puis tenez-les. \q Que toutes les nations autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q apportent des cadeaux au Dieu que tous doivent craindre.

sw.L: Wekeni nadhiri na mzitimize kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu; \q wote walio kandokando {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q na wamletee zawadi Yeye wa Kutisha.
sw.B: Mwekeeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu nadhiri, mkazitimize; \q wote wanaomzunguka \q na wamletee kodi Yeye aletaye hofu.
sw.R: Mwahidini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, kisha mzitimize ahadi zenu. \q Mataifa yote yanayomzunguka \q na yamletee zawadi Mungu ambaye kila mtu lazima amwogope.

es.L: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} votos y {{plural_you:cumplan|cumplid}} [los votos] {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}; \q que todos los que están alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q traigan un presente al Temible.
es.B: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} votos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{plural_you:cumplan|cumplid}} lo que {{plural_you:prometan|prometáis}}; \q que todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodean \q traigan tributo al que inspira temor.
es.R: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} promesas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y luego {{plural_you:cúmplanlas|cumplidlas}}. \q Que todas las naciones que están alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q traigan regalos al Dios a quien todos deben temer.

vi.L: Hãy hứa nguyện và trả [lời hứa nguyện] cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của mình; \q nguyện mọi kẻ ở chung quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q đem lễ vật đến dâng Đấng Đáng Sợ.
vi.B: Hãy hứa nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của mình, và giữ trọn điều mình hứa; \q nguyện mọi dân chung quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q đem cống phẩm đến dâng Đấng đáng kính sợ.
vi.R: Hãy hứa dâng lễ vật cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của mình, rồi giữ lời hứa ấy. \q Nguyện mọi dân tộc chung quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q đem lễ vật đến dâng Đức Chúa Trời mà mọi người phải kính sợ.

ko.L: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께 서원하고 [그것을] 갚아라. \q 그분의 주위에 있는 모든 이는 \q 두려우신 분께 예물을 드려라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께 서원하고, 서원한 것을 지켜라. \q 그분을 둘러싼 모든 이는 \q 두려움을 일으키시는 분께 예물을 바쳐라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께 약속을 하고 그 약속을 지켜라. \q 그분 주위의 모든 민족은 \q 모두가 두려워해야 할 하나님께 선물을 가져오너라.

decisions.choice: vow and pay: promise an offering and give it
decisions.reason: A vow was a promise to give God an offering, often made in trouble and paid after rescue (22:26; 50:14). Those God has saved are to keep their promises.

decisions.choice: all around him: the surrounding peoples
decisions.reason: "All around him" may be the nations surrounding Israel, who bring tribute to the God who broke the armies (68:30), or the people standing around him in worship.

decisions.choice: the Fearsome One: a title of God
decisions.reason: The word (mora') means fear or what is feared; here it names God himself, the one who is to be feared (verse 8).

decisions.choice: all the nations around him
decisions.reason: Readable follows the likelier sense (m2).

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời của mình" (your God) for the plural "you"
decisions.reason: The call goes out to the gathered people. Vietnamese "mình" lets the command speak to all of them without choosing a pronoun that sounds cold ("các người") or only male ("anh em").

records.literal_gloss: He cuts off [the] spirit of rulers; fearsome to [the] kings of [the] earth.

en.L: He cuts off the spirit of rulers; \q [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] fearsome to the kings of the earth.
en.B: He cuts short the breath of princes; \q the kings of the earth stand in fear of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: He humbles proud rulers. \q The kings of the earth are afraid of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Il retranche le souffle des princes ; \q [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] redoutable pour les rois de la terre.
fr.B: Il coupe court au souffle des princes ; \q les rois de la terre {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent.
fr.R: Il abaisse les chefs orgueilleux. \q Les rois de la terre ont peur de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Huikata roho ya watawala; \q [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni] wa kutisha kwa wafalme wa dunia.
sw.B: Hukatiza pumzi ya wakuu; \q wafalme wa dunia humwogopa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.R: Huwanyenyekeza watawala wenye kiburi. \q Wafalme wa dunia wanamwogopa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.

es.L: Él corta el aliento de los príncipes; \q [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es] temible para los reyes de la tierra.
es.B: Él corta el aliento de los príncipes; \q los reyes de la tierra {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tienen miedo.
es.R: Él humilla a los gobernantes orgullosos. \q Los reyes de la tierra {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tienen miedo.

vi.L: Ngài cắt đứt tâm khí của các vua chúa; \q [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng] đáng sợ đối với các vua trên đất.
vi.B: Ngài cắt ngắn hơi thở của các vương hầu; \q các vua trên đất đều kinh sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài hạ những kẻ cai trị kiêu ngạo xuống. \q Các vua trên đất đều sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분께서는 통치자들의 기를 꺾으시니, \q 땅의 왕들에게 두려운 분[이시다].
ko.B: 그분께서는 통치자들의 숨을 끊으시니, \q 땅의 왕들이 그분을 두려워한다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 교만한 통치자들을 낮추신다. \q 땅의 왕들이 그분을 두려워한다.

decisions.choice: cuts off: harvests, cuts down
decisions.reason: The verb (batsar) is used for cutting off grapes at the harvest. God cuts rulers down as easily as grapes are picked.

decisions.choice: spirit: pride, or the breath of life
decisions.reason: The spirit (ruach) may be the proud spirit of rulers or their very breath: God breaks their pride or ends their lives.

decisions.choice: cuts short the breath (B); humbles proud (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of life cut short; Readable gives its plainest result (m2).
